section-29-1.FOR: A person (a “service-provider”) concerned with the provision of a service to the public or a section of the public (for payment or not)
section-29-1.TO: discriminate against a person requiring the service by not providing the person with the service
section-29-1.UNLESS: this concerns the protected characteristic of—(a) age, so far as relating to persons who have not attained the age of 18; (b) marriage and civil partnership
section-29-1.UNLESS_2: this concerns discrimination, harassment or victimisation— (a) that is prohibited by Part 4 (premises), 5 (work) or 6 (education), or (b) that would be so prohibited but for an express exception
section-29-1.UNLESS_3: this concerns — (a) a breach of an equality clause or rule; (b) anything that would be a breach of an equality clause or rule but for section 69 or Part 2 of Schedule 7; (c) a breach of a non-discrimination rule

section-29-2.TO: discriminate against a person (B)— (a) as to the terms on which A provides the service to B; (b) by terminating the provision of the service to B; (c) by subjecting B to any other detriment
section-29-2.UNLESS: this concerns the protected characteristic of—(a) age, so far as relating to persons who have not attained the age of 18; (b) marriage and civil partnership
section-29-2.UNLESS_2: this concerns discrimination, harassment or victimisation— (a) that is prohibited by Part 4 (premises), 5 (work) or 6 (education), or (b) that would be so prohibited but for an express exception
section-29-2.UNLESS_3: this concerns — (a) a breach of an equality clause or rule; (b) anything that would be a breach of an equality clause or rule but for section 69 or Part 2 of Schedule 7; (c) a breach of a non-discrimination rule

section-29-3.TO: harass— (a) a person requiring the service, or (b) a person to whom the service-provider provides the service
section-29-3.UNLESS: this concerns the protected characteristic of—(a) age, so far as relating to persons who have not attained the age of 18; (b) marriage and civil partnership
section-29-3.UNLESS_2: this concerns discrimination, harassment or victimisation— (a) that is prohibited by Part 4 (premises), 5 (work) or 6 (education), or (b) that would be so prohibited but for an express exception
section-29-3.UNLESS_3: this concerns — (a) a breach of an equality clause or rule; (b) anything that would be a breach of an equality clause or rule but for section 69 or Part 2 of Schedule 7; (c) a breach of a non-discrimination rule

section-29-4.TO: victimise a person requiring the service by not providing the person with the service
section-29-4.UNLESS: this concerns the protected characteristic of—(a) age, so far as relating to persons who have not attained the age of 18; (b) marriage and civil partnership
section-29-4.UNLESS_2: this concerns discrimination, harassment or victimisation— (a) that is prohibited by Part 4 (premises), 5 (work) or 6 (education), or (b) that would be so prohibited but for an express exception
section-29-4.UNLESS_3: this concerns — (a) a breach of an equality clause or rule; (b) anything that would be a breach of an equality clause or rule but for section 69 or Part 2 of Schedule 7; (c) a breach of a non-discrimination rule

section-29-5.TO: victimise a person (B)— (a) as to the terms on which A provides the service to B; (b) by terminating the provision of the service to B; (c) by subjecting B to any other detriment
section-29-5.UNLESS: this concerns the protected characteristic of—(a) age, so far as relating to persons who have not attained the age of 18; (b) marriage and civil partnership
section-29-5.UNLESS_2: this concerns discrimination, harassment or victimisation— (a) that is prohibited by Part 4 (premises), 5 (work) or 6 (education), or (b) that would be so prohibited but for an express exception
section-29-5.UNLESS_3: this concerns — (a) a breach of an equality clause or rule; (b) anything that would be a breach of an equality clause or rule but for section 69 or Part 2 of Schedule 7; (c) a breach of a non-discrimination rule

section-29-6.TO: do anything that constitutes discrimination, harassment or victimisation
section-29-6.IN: the exercise of a public function that is not the provision of a service to the public or a section of the public
section-29-6.UNLESS: this concerns the protected characteristic of—(a) age, so far as relating to persons who have not attained the age of 18; (b) marriage and civil partnership
section-29-6.UNLESS_2: this concerns discrimination, harassment or victimisation— (a) that is prohibited by Part 4 (premises), 5 (work) or 6 (education), or (b) that would be so prohibited but for an express exception
section-29-6.UNLESS_3: this concerns — (a) a breach of an equality clause or rule; (b) anything that would be a breach of an equality clause or rule but for section 69 or Part 2 of Schedule 7; (c) a breach of a non-discrimination rule

section-29-7.FOR: — (a) a service-provider (and see also section 55(7)); (b) a person who exercises a public function that is not the provision of a service to the public or a section of the public
section-29-7.UNLESS: this concerns the protected characteristic of—(a) age, so far as relating to persons who have not attained the age of 18; (b) marriage and civil partnership
section-29-7.UNLESS_2: this concerns discrimination, harassment or victimisation— (a) that is prohibited by Part 4 (premises), 5 (work) or 6 (education), or (b) that would be so prohibited but for an express exception
section-29-7.UNLESS_3: this concerns — (a) a breach of an equality clause or rule; (b) anything that would be a breach of an equality clause or rule but for section 69 or Part 2 of Schedule 7; (c) a breach of a non-discrimination rule
